# PRT011 `literal-kind`

<Badge type="warning" text="warning" /> <Badge type="tip" text="enabled by default" />

A kind given as a number in a type declaration (`real(8)`, `integer(kind=4)`).

## Why

Kind numbers are compiler-specific: `real(8)` is double precision for gfortran and ifx, but kind
values are not defined by the standard and differ elsewhere (NAG uses 1, 2, 3). Use named
constants from `iso_fortran_env` (`real64`, `int32`) or `selected_real_kind`.

## Reported

```fortran
real(8) :: x
```

## Preferred

```fortran
real(real64) :: x
```

## Suppressing

For one occurrence, with the reason on the same line (or alone on the line before the statement):

```fortran
! fobis: ignore[PRT011] <why this occurrence is fine>
```

For the whole project, `ignore = PRT011` in the fobos [`[lint]` section](/fobos/lint).
